comment: Controls what `npm run discover:assets` emits for conversion. `sets`: "all" for every cosmetic set folder, or a curated array of set names (e.g. ["ActionHero","Ninja"]) to bound the batch. `hairs`/`heads`: include all hairstyles / Face_* heads. Narrow this if the full ~900-mesh Blender run is too long; convert in chunks with `npm run convert:meshes 0:200`.
